title: Coding From the Himalayas With an Offline AI Agent
author: Rittika Jindal
description: How to set up and run an offline coding agent using OpenCode, Ollama and Qwen.
summary: When we talk about working remotely , we take a lot of things for granted, especially reliable internet and power. But sometimes, working remotely means trying to get something done on a flight, during a long train ride, or somewhere with little or no network.
takeaways: I wanted a model we could run locally that could also use an agent’s tools.
BFCL-V4 evaluates function calling, which matters when a model needs to choose a tool and give it the right arguments.
Coding agents are already a big part of my everyday workflow, which made me curious about how much of that workflow I could keep using offline.
